title: ticfac authors image/: end the vendoring from ticks cloud/sandbox
description: sandbox.pin.json says ticks authors the tree and ticfac never edits image/. Flip it: image/ is ticfac source; delete cmd/sandbox sync/verify-upstream and internal/sandboxpin (or reduce to a record of provenance), the CI sandbox verify job, and restate 5bp as superseded. Move the Go suite that runs the scripts (ticks internal/sandbox) or its essential cases into ticfac.
notes:
2026-09-27 10:47 - When ticfac owns image/, bump ARG GO_VERSION to at least 1.26 (2026-09-27). Hegel (property-based testing) requires Go 1.26: #58 added it and #59 removed it again, because it raised go.mod's floor above the image's Go 1.24.11 and 152's floor check refused that. After the bump, restore the two property tests from 4c990f79 (internal/profile/cloudrule_pbt_test.go and internal/forge/ci_pbt_test.go) and continue 89g.
2026-09-27 11:07 - Operator, 2026-09-27: 'probably good to have sandbox on latest go anyhow'. So bump ARG GO_VERSION to the LATEST Go release (1.26.x as of today), not merely the floor, and keep it current. Workers build and test repos in the sandbox, so an old toolchain there is a class of bug, and check 152 guards the floor.
2026-09-27 12:25 - When ticfac owns image/: image/worker.sh and image/README.md still say TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT is 'printable ASCII'. Since #66 the door accepts valid UTF-8 prose (no control characters except tab/LF/CR, at most 65536 bytes). Fix the comments; ticks no longer carries cloud/sandbox, so this is ticfac's to change.
2026-09-27 22:53 - 2jn findings 2b4d3849 (image die messages still say 'tk factory setup': grep -n 'tk factory' image/common.sh image/Dockerfile) and 700eb908 (image/README.md should point at ticfac's go.mod-floor guard, check 152) were routed to ticks before image/ moved; discarded there and carried here.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] image/ is edited directly in ticfac and CI no longer fetches ticks cloud/sandbox. [A2] The scripts' behaviour tests run in ticfac CI. [V] Verified by: make vet && make gate, and in cloudflare/: pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run.
